title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Personal Transportation Vehicles (PTV), Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear seat structure of the PTV can fail, resulting in the rear seat tilting unexpectedly, posing fall and injury hazards to the riders. Units: About 280.

title: Children's Robes Recalled by HulovoX Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled robes fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 3,500.

title: Giant Bicycle Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The adjustable handlebar stem on the bicycles can become loose, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 20,800.

title: Bella Elevator Recalls Residential Elevators Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate if there is a hazardous gap, and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 10,500.

title: Inclinator Company of America Recalls Residential Elevators Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate if there is a hazardous gap, and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 39,300.

title: Residential Elevators Recalled by Savaria Corporation Due to Child Entrapment Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury or Death to Young Children
summary: Young children can become entrapped in the space between the exterior landing (hoistway) door and the interior elevator car door or gate due to a hazardous gap, and suffer serious injuries or death when the elevator is called to another floor. Units: About 19,500.

title: Colony Brands Recalls Children's Wood Wagons Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban and Lead Poisoning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Paint on the wood wagons, the plastic handles, and the red plastic cover contain levels of lead that exceed the maximums allowed. Excessive levels of lead can be toxic or cause other health problems to young children if the paint is ingested. Units: About 20.

title: Polaris Recalls Youth All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The inner layer of the fuel line can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,100 (In addition, two units in Canada).

title: Native Creation Recalls Sweaters Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban
summary: Paint on the zipper pull contains levels of lead that exceed the maximums allowed. Excessive levels of lead can be toxic or cause other health problems to young children if the paint is ingested. Units: About 170.

title: Johnson Health Tech Recalls Matrix T1 and T3 Commercial Treadmills Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The power cord can become loose from the treadmill's power socket, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,900 (In addition, about 17 in Canada).

title: Children's Nightgowns Recalled by AOSKERA Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled nightgowns fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,000.

title: DeWALT Recalls 18-inch Corded Chain Saws Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The chain saw can remain running when the switch is on the off position or turn on when plugged in, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 8,500.

title: Eguana Technologies Recalls Evolve Home Energy Storage Systems with LG Battery Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion battery modules within the Evolve Home Energy Storage Systems can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 245.

title: Family Dollar Recalls Beach Loungers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled loungers can collapse unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard if fingers get caught in the metal folding joints. Units: About 800.

title: Children's Sleepwear Garments Recalled by Childrensalon Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled children's sleepwear garments fail to meet the United States flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 180.

title: Mushie & Co Recalls FRIGG Silicone Pacifiers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The base of the silicone nipple has a fine slit that can cause the nipple to detach from the plastic shield, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 333,725.
